components.name: ICS-VEX Reverse SBOM Builder
components.description: Reverse-builds a CycloneDX SBOM-CVE per ICS device from the CISA ICS-CERT advisory corpus.

component.name: Siemens SCALANCE W700
component.description: ICS/OT asset 'SCALANCE W700' by Siemens, reverse-built from CISA ICS-CERT advisory data.

externalReferences.comment: Source CISA ICS-CERT advisories: icsa-23-320-05, icsa-24-165-12, icsa-24-256-13, icsa-25-044-09

components.name: SCALANCE W700 Vendor Firmware/Application
components.description: Vendor firmware/application inventory placeholder; source not publicly available.

components.name: libxml2
components.description: XML processor used to parse configuration files such as IEC 61850 SCL and PLCopen XML.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.description: TLS/SSL and general-purpose cryptography library. Handles the device's secure communication channels and certificate processing.

components.name: OpenSSH
components.description: SSH server/client used for remote management and secure file transfer.
